headline_stat.name: POST-sleep significant replay fraction (vs PRE at chance)

justification.dataset: DANDI 000044 Achilles CA1 linear-track session is the canonical Buzsáki dataset for place cells, sharp-wave ripples, and replay.
justification.handling: Real 8.7 GB NWB streamed via remfile, correct LFP uV conversion, Non-REM state masking, run-bout linearization, and explicit excitatory/place-cell filtering.
justification.analysis: Standard pipeline: Skaggs SI circular-shift shuffle for place cells, Bayesian ripple decoding, weighted time-position correlation with a 500x cell-ID shuffle null, and binomial/Fisher/Mann-Whitney PRE-vs-POST tests.
justification.correctness: Numbers reproduce to within a single event, but the README headline (36/9.5%, binom 2.2e-04, 28 forward) does not exactly match the committed replay.npz (35/9.2%, 4.5e-04, 27 forward).
justification.figures: Figures are clearly labeled with units and sample sizes and show the effect plainly: diagonal place-field template, sharp-wave-ripple triggered average, and clean posterior trajectory sweeps.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate, the modest 9.5% individually-significant fraction and forward/reverse split are reported honestly with PRE pinned at chance, but no specific limitations (single session) are named.
